tech.name: links present in PDF
tech.detail: 9415 link annotations for 9415 links in the source

coverage.where: listing.title, listing.description, start, PDF link annotations
coverage.note: One 453-page portrait PDF; Goodnotes is the first app named in the title, description and Start here step 1; all 9415 links are plain /Dest page links (no URI, JS or app tricks).
12 undated month pages (blank 6x7 grids), Week 1-52 not tied to months, 364 day pages with 'date ____'; no year printed anywhere.

Checked in the PDF: all 453 pages reachable from cover; 12 month tabs on every page; Weeks page links all 52; every week links its 7 days; all 364 day pages link prev/next incl. Sunday->next Monday; every week and day page has a Weeks / Week trail. Trail links are only 11 pt tall (see visual).

coverage.where: year, m01-m12, m01h-m12h, w01-w52, u010, lists, notes-notes6
coverage.note: Year overview, 12 months with Goals this month and Notes, 12 habit trackers (14 habits x 31 days), 52 weeks, day pages with Top 3/To do/Time blocks/Notes, Lists page, 6 notes pages.
Only Cormorant Garamond and Manrope embedded; consistent margins and card radii; month tabs run indigo (Jan) to soft gold (Dec).
Start here (4 steps), Setup check, and a 'How the links work' note on Contents are printed in the file; the Contents note says 'Month / Week trail' but pages show 'Weeks / Week N' (see visual).

coverage.where: files/Any-Monday.pdf, listing.description 'How to start', photo-09-ph9.jpg, start
coverage.note: Single PDF, 12.17 MB, no zip; listing and photo 9 give web-browser download, Share > Open in Goodnotes or New > Import; Start here step 1 repeats it (without the New > Import route).
Open planner links to Start here; 4 steps (open it, check links, Start with Week 1 + Go there button, pen off/on) and a 12-month grid below; the next PDF page is Setup check; no stickers or add-ons.

coverage.where: PDF page size, listing.description 'Works with', linktest
coverage.note: All pages 576 x 768 pt (3:4, i.e. 768 x 1024 CSS px); listing has the Works with / Not made for phones, e-ink, Files, Photos, Drive preview text; Setup check tests links. Note: only 12.9/13-inch iPads are exactly 3:4; 11-inch iPads will show thin bands top/bottom (sides are fine, so the listing wording holds).

coverage.where: top bar on every page; u010, u182, u354, w01, w27
coverage.note: Day and week layouts are identical everywhere (5 boxes / 2 columns), but the top bar is Home, Year, Notes, Weeks: Lists is not on the top bar of any page (reachable only from a Contents card).

coverage.where: PDF link map, weeks, w27, u182
coverage.note: Month tabs on every page, Weeks on top bar opens all 52, weeks link 7 days, day arrows cross Sunday->Monday on all 51 week edges, week arrows go to the following week, trails on every week/day page.

Description lists page counts, undated, portrait only, Monday start, no stickers, not fillable, English only; photos are real screenshots. But photo 6 is captioned 'linktest' (internal anchor), not the page name 'Setup check'.
Setup check has A month page / The year / Contents buttons (each links correctly) and a 4-line Nothing happened? list ending in 'Send the shop an Etsy message'; every page reachable from the cover.
FAQ covers Etsy app download, which app, pen-on links, typing, undated weeks; Help says Setup check then Etsy message; no reply-time promise in listing or PDF (r007 ok).

Undated and the not-inside list (no budget, meal, fitness) are there, but photos 2-4 are not close-ups: each crop keeps ~90% of the page, shown at ~40% of the photo width, so box labels are tiny at Etsy zoom.
Writing room is generous (half the day page is time blocks + lines; each weekday has its own lined box), but photo 2 shows the day page smaller than on-screen size, not about twice it.
Weeks page lists Week 1-52 each with a 'starts ____' line; Start here step 3: open Week 1, write this Monday's date, start on today; month grids are 6 rows x 7 (42 boxes).
3:4 pages; week page is Mon-Thu left, Fri-Sun + Notes right, with This week's top 3 and Next week underneath (notes box sits in the right column, not underneath).
Jump buttons to a month, the year and Contents; pen test box; Nothing happened? fix list; top-bar map (Home, Year, Notes, Weeks).
Time blocks 6am to 9pm in the right column beside Top 3 on every day page shot.
Background #FBF9F4 and ink #1E2238 measured; indigo-to-gold tabs; Cormorant headings and italic labels, Manrope body; no tracked all-caps labels.

r013 not fixed for photos 5, 6 and 7: each shows a whole page shrunk into a tablet mockup; body text is about 12 px tall in a 2000 px photo, unreadable at Etsy zoom.

Photos 2-4 'zooms' crop x 0.03-0.925 and y 0.05-0.976, i.e. ~90% of the page, shown at ~40% of the photo width beside a large empty copy area; labels like Top 3, To do, Mon are tiny. Crop to a real close-up (e.g. top half of the page) and fill the frame.
Photo 6 caption reads 'linktest' (internal anchor name) instead of 'Setup check'.

Tap targets still small: top-bar pills are 34-44 x 19 pt on every page (~27 pt on an 11-inch iPad), the Weeks / Week trail links are 11 pt tall on all 416 week and day pages (the only day-to-week link), notes page-number pills are 22 x 19 pt, month-page Habit tracker / All weeks buttons 23 pt tall.
